title: Water-Ghost
meaning: A drowned spirit; water that remembers the dead

definitions.en: The ghost of one who drowned; a spirit dwelling in water.

definitions.zh: 〈引申〉水面上隱約可見之光影，如月光映於暗池。
definitions.en: (Extended) A faint luminance on water’s surface, as moonlight caught in a dark pool.

definitions.zh: 〈比喻〉無法釋懷之往事，沉於心底如水鬼不去。
definitions.en: (Figurative) A memory that will not release its hold, lingering in the depths like a water-ghost.

etymology:
Every body of water in China has its drowned. The fishermen know them,
the poets know them, and the characters ought to know them too. That
water should have its own word for haunting feels not invented but
overdue — a character that the river has been waiting to be written.

source.gloss: ⿰氵鬼，水中之鬼也。溺而不返者，其魂附於水。過委切。

examples.text: 夜半渡河，舟人曰：「此水多⿰氵鬼，不可久留。」
examples.translation: Crossing the river at midnight, the boatman said: “These waters are full of water-ghosts — we must not linger.”

examples.text: 她盯著湖面看了很久，說那裡有⿰氵鬼在等她。
examples.translation: She stared at the lake for a long time and said there was a water-ghost waiting for her there.
